title: Zoom leverages AssemblyAI to help advance its AI research and development
summary: AssemblyAI's industry-leading Speech AI models were selected to help advance Zoom’s research and development efforts around speech-to-text by using these models to refine data used to train Zoom’s AI Companion, strengthening Zoom’s ability to deliver high-performance AI features.
body_markdown:
CBB Labs built Sangs, a voice agent powered by AssemblyAI, for DanceHall Studios, a studio-management platform for South Asian classical dance schools. With Sangs, one studio now completes 4× more daily work and saves 6 hours weekly.
